blocks.text: Thermochemistry tabee ya kimiyai tabdeeliyon ke dauran jazb ya kharij hone wali hararati energy ki miqdar ka mutala hai; ise energetics bhi kehte hain aur yeh bari had tak thermodynamics ke pehle qanoon par qaim hai. Hess ka qanoon, pehle qanoon ki ek khas soorat, chemist ke hath mein ek numayan auzaar hai jis ke analytical chemistry mein be-shumar istemal hain, aur thermodynamics yeh bhi batati hai ke koi khas reaction muqarrar halaat mein ho sakti hai ya nahi, yani reaction ki khud-ba-khudi (spontaneity).

blocks.title: Enthalpy aur enthalpy ki tabdeeli
blocks.text: Kisi madde ki apni banawat (bonds ki qismein) aur tabee halat ki wajah se energy us ka heat content ya enthalpy, H, hai. Har madde ki makhsoos enthalpy hoti hai, to products ki kul enthalpy (HP) reactants ki (HR) ke kabhi barabar nahi hoti, aur reaction enthalpy mein tabdeeli lati hai, delta H = HP - HR: hararat ki soorat mein kharij ya jazb hone wali kul energy.

items: HP HR se kam: enthalpy girti hai, HP - HR ke barabar hararat kharij hoti hai, aur delta H manfi hai. Woh kimiyai reaction ya tabee tabdeeli jis mein hararat system se mahol ko kharij ho exothermic amal hai; oxygen mein carbon ka jalna, C(s) + O2(g) se CO2(g), delta H = -393.7 kJ fi mol.

HP HR se zyada: enthalpy barhti hai, HP - HR ke barabar hararat jazb hoti hai, aur delta H musbat hai. Woh reaction ya tabdeeli jis mein system mahol se hararat jazb kare endothermic amal hai; pani mein ammonium chloride ka halna, NH4Cl(s) se NH4+(aq) + Cl-(aq), delta H = +16.2 kJ fi mol.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Ammonium chloride ka endothermic halna choton ke liye cold packs (ice packs) mein istemal hota hai: pack masalne se pani aur NH4Cl crystals milte hain, mahol se energy jazb hoti hai, aur pack thanda mehsoos hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Exothermic reaction ke liye HR ya HP mein kaun bara hai, aur farq kahan jata hai?
blocks.explanation: HR, reactants ki enthalpy, bari hai. Farq HP - HR manfi hai aur system se mahol ko di gai hararat ke taur par nikalta hai, isi liye mixture garam hota hai.

items: Thermochemistry (energetics) jazb ya kharij hararat ka mutala hai; yeh thermodynamics ke pehle qanoon par qaim hai, Hess ka qanoon us ki khas soorat hai.

Enthalpy H heat content hai; delta H = HP - HR. Exothermic: HP < HR, delta H manfi, hararat kharij (C + O2, -393.7 kJ fi mol). Endothermic: HP > HR, delta H musbat, hararat jazb (NH4Cl halna, +16.2 kJ fi mol, cold packs).
